Dehydrated Tomato Flakes Supplier India for Wholesale and Export

Dehydrated tomato flakes are small dried pieces of ripe tomato used in seasonings, soups, sauces, snack coatings and ready meals. Tradenest Naturals is a dehydrated tomato flakes supplier in India, selling to food manufacturers, importers, distributors, restaurants, QSR chains and private label brands. The tomatoes are carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers, then dried under controlled conditions so the flakes keep their red colour, aroma and tangy-sweet taste. As a manufacturer and dehydrated tomato flakes exporter, we handle bulk orders, custom packing, private label projects and regular export programmes. Compared with fresh tomatoes, the flakes store longer, need no preparation, cut down on handling losses and are available all year. You can rehydrate them for cooking or add them straight into seasoning blends, instant foods, sauces, soups, bakery items, snack coatings and ready-to-cook mixes. Contact Tradenest Naturals to request a sample, the product specification sheet, a packaging proposal or a current dehydrated tomato flakes price.

Product Overview

Our dehydrated tomato flakes are made by cleaning, sorting, cutting and drying fresh tomatoes. Removing the water concentrates the natural tomato flavour. The finished flakes are free-flowing and sized for industrial food processing and foodservice. Depending on your use, they can be rehydrated before cooking or mixed directly into dry blends. The product is made for B2B buyers. It is available as our standard 8-16 mesh flake or to a buyer specification for packaging format, label layout and how the flakes perform in your recipe. Our aim is steady batch-to-batch consistency, with enough flexibility to meet different market and formulation needs.

Manufacturing and Processing

Fresh tomatoes are inspected for ripeness, visible defects, foreign material and suitability for processing. Approved tomatoes are washed and cut before going into dehydrators with controlled temperature and airflow. Drying lowers the water content to support long storage while keeping the character of the tomato. After drying, the flakes are cooled, inspected, sieved and sealed in food-grade, moisture-resistant packaging. Batch identification and production records give traceability from raw material intake to dispatch. Where needed, Tradenest Naturals reviews custom requirements for cut size, packaging and destination-market documents before production is signed off.

Typical Technical Specifications

  • Form: Dehydrated tomato flakes
  • Typical particle size: 8-16 mesh; other sizes can be reviewed on request
  • Mesh reference: 8-16 mesh
  • Moisture: ≤ 5%
  • Purity: Single-ingredient tomato flakes, with foreign matter controlled to the agreed specification
  • Color: Natural red to deep red
  • Flavor: Typical sweet, savoury and mildly tangy tomato taste
  • Additives: No added colour or flavour in the standard product
  • Packaging: Food-grade inner liner with outer carton, bag, jar or custom export format
Colour and taste can vary a little with tomato variety and season. The final values for each order are set out in the agreed product specification. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. Buyers should check destination-country rules on labelling, permitted ingredients and allergen declarations before commercial dispatch.

Quality, Safety, and Documentation

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI registered food business. Our food-safety practices cover raw material inspection, moisture control, batch tracking, sieving, packaging checks and routine quality checks. Each batch is compared with the agreed specification. We do not claim certifications that have not been confirmed for a specific order. Standard export paperwork includes the product specification sheet, batch details, packing list, commercial invoice and certificate of origin where applicable. Requirements differ between buyers, destinations and end uses. If your programme needs specific audits, documents or tests, please tell us at the enquiry stage. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. As an IEC registered exporter, we provide export documentation support and issue only the documents that apply to the confirmed shipment.

Applications

Bulk dehydrated tomato flakes are popular for their concentrated flavour, easy handling and reliable storage. They are used in:
  • Tomato soups, sauces, gravies and curry bases
  • Pizza, pasta, noodle and meal seasoning blends
  • Instant soups, ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat products
  • Snack coatings, namkeen, chips, crackers and savoury mixes
  • Bakery fillings, savoury breads, biscuits and crackers
  • Restaurant, hotel, catering, cloud kitchen and QSR recipes
  • Dry premixes, spice blends, stuffing mixes and meal kits
  • Custom recipes that need visible tomato pieces
For sauces, soups and gravies, soak or simmer the flakes in water, stock, oil or another liquid. In dry seasonings, they blend in well once you have confirmed the texture and distribution you want. We recommend a pilot trial, because rehydration depends on cut size, processing conditions, recipe and serving format.

Buyer Value

  • Longer storage convenience: With moisture at 5% or less, the flakes keep far longer than fresh tomatoes when stored properly.
  • Reduced preparation work: Ready-to-use dried pieces remove the need for washing, slicing and trimming.
  • Year-round availability: A dried format helps you plan production without depending on the fresh tomato season.
  • Lower handling losses: Dry flakes are easier to portion, ship and store than perishable fresh produce.
  • Consistent formulation input: A controlled cut size and clear specification help keep recipes repeatable.
  • Flexible procurement: Standard, bulk, private label and custom supply options suit businesses of different sizes.

Packaging and Shelf Life

Standard packs include 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg and 25 kg, depending on stock and project needs. Export shipments use moisture-resistant, food-grade inner liners inside strong outer cartons or bags. PET jars, HDPE containers, stand-up pouches, bulk bags, custom printed packaging and OEM and private label formats are all available for approved projects. Shelf life is 12 months from manufacture in unopened packs stored as recommended. The shelf life, packaging details and expiry date are shown on the product specification and label. Store in a cool, dry, clean place away from direct sunlight, heat, humidity, strong odours and chemicals. Reseal opened packs tightly and use clean, dry utensils.

MOQ, Lead Time, Samples, and Quotations

What is the minimum order quantity for dehydrated tomato flakes from a supplier in India? Our MOQ is 5 Kg. This lets you start with a trial order before moving to regular volumes. Private label projects, custom printed packaging, special cut sizes and OEM work are quoted separately. We confirm the final terms once we know the product profile, destination, packaging and volume. Lead time depends on raw material availability, production schedule and the approval of specifications, packaging proofs and payment terms. We confirm a realistic dispatch date with each quotation. Custom or private label orders need extra time for artwork approval and packaging materials. To request a sample or price quote, share your volume, destination country, preferred packaging, application, target specification and any private label needs. Tradenest Naturals will check feasibility, share product data and send a full commercial offer.

Why Work with Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals brings together manufacturing, bulk supply, export handling, private label packing and formulation support. Buyers source dehydrated tomato flakes from a partner focused on practical specifications, clear communication and dependable B2B service. Our team helps importers, wholesalers, FMCG brands, food processors, hospitality operators and distributors with packaging, documents and repeat-order planning. Whether you are comparing wholesale dehydrated tomato flakes, testing a new ingredient for an industrial recipe or looking for a dependable dehydrated tomato flakes manufacturer for export, we are ready to help. The final dehydrated tomato flakes price depends on order volume, season, cut profile, packaging, destination and Incoterms. Send your enquiry to discuss the right supply arrangement for your business.

Frequently Asked Questions

What certifications and quality standards apply?

Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI registered food business and IEC registered exporter. We follow documented food-safety practices, raw material inspection, moisture control and batch traceability. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost.

What are the typical mesh, moisture, and purity values?

The standard product is dehydrated tomato flakes at 8-16 mesh with moisture of 5% or less. It is a single-ingredient product with no added colour or flavour. Final values are confirmed in the product specification sheet.

Can I request a sample?

Yes. Send us your application, destination country, quantity and preferred specification so our team can check sample stock and arrange shipping.
